scguns.desc.gnasher: The First and most popular mass-produced weapon by the Rabble of Outcast Thralls. Its compact and modular nature was invaluable to those who search for resources in the tight underground structures.
scguns.desc.choppa: A heavy pistol affixed with a diamond cleaver bayonet, this weapon has been designed to eke out every bit of potential from its subpar ammunition.
scguns.desc.choppa_conversion: A retrofit originally coming from an area underground with plentiful resources. Surprisingly, this gun was created by an unknown former prisoner, as opposed to the expected scientist or miner of ROT.
scguns.desc.nebilitsa: Once upon a time, this was a tool used to weld and blast stone away from precious materials. When monsters appeared underground, miners discovered this weapon's devastating effectiveness as a weapon.
scguns.desc.wringman: A minigun equipped with a sinister bladed shroud, this weapon was created by ROT scientists for the prisoners and miners they could trust to use it.
scguns.desc.grub_frame: ROT scientists put their original creeds aside to survive in this new world underground, and by mixing their creations together, a creature that could be used to produce living weapons was created.
scguns.desc.millend_overdrive: A first test of the Grub Frame on an antique yielded a hulking, unwieldy powerhouse of a firearm. The grub demands and rewards techniques that the average body simply cant keep up with.
scguns.desc.raygun_mk2: A weapon devised by a former eccentric COG scientist, the Grub concealed within unleashes rapid, if infrequent, bolts of deadly plasma.
scguns.desc.lug: The Grub within this weapon produces a pressurized gas, launching heavy shotballs at lethal speeds. Users without respirators frequently remark that this is not worth the attack on their nostrils.
scguns.desc.wormroot_needle: An innovation from a former Asgharian scientist Dr. Jag, a concoction has rendered a Grub docile enough to use as a potent venomous bio-weapon, but its invasive nature means it is seldom used by the masses of ROT.
